updateAnnouncement.body.text:
Version 0.4.10

New and improved:
· Import Workshop collections: download missing mods, save as a profile, or save and apply
· Downloads: follow collection, friend-list, list-import and update downloads in one place; retry stalled items
· Uninstall and unsubscribe: confirm first, then remove the item from the manager; Steam cleans up files after the game quits
· Tools button: downloads, local imports, logs and usage tips in the list’s lower-right corner
· Hide filters for more room; Download All Updates stays available
· Guided usage tips: previews restore your settings afterwards; See what’s new tours this release’s additions

loading.error.disableToggle.tooltip.text: When on, continuing unloads this mod first, and it stays off next time.

loading.error.keepContinue.context: Load-error action that keeps the failing mod as it is and continues loading (or starts the game if it was the last mod). Becomes Unload & Continue while the switch is on.

loading.error.keepContinue.tooltip.text: Keep this mod as it is and carry on launching. Fine for small errors when you still want to play; some of its features may not work, and it could affect other mods.

loading.error.kept.text: Ignored the error in {name}; launching goes on.
loading.error.kept.context: Launcher status strip after the player ignores a load error.

name.description: Display name of the mod that failed to load.

loading.error.keptLog.text: ! Ignored the error in {name} and kept loading.
loading.error.keptLog.context: Loading log line after the player ignores a load error. Must not start with the ▶ marker of a loading mod.

name.description: Display name of the mod that failed to load.

loading.error.keptPreparing.text: Ignored the error in {name}; getting the game ready…
loading.error.keptPreparing.context: Loading status after ignoring an error in the last mod of the queue.

name.description: Display name of the mod that failed to load.

loading.error.keptContinuing.text: Ignored the error in {name}; loading the other mods…
loading.error.keptContinuing.context: Loading status after ignoring an error with more mods still to load.

name.description: Display name of the mod that failed to load.

loading.error.summary.failed.text: {name} didn't load. Its features won't work this time, and mods that need it may have problems too.
loading.error.summary.failed.context: First line of the load-error panel when the mod failed to load.

name.description: Display name of the mod that failed to load.

loading.error.summary.startFailed.text: {name} failed to start. Most of its features probably won't work this time, and it could affect other mods.
loading.error.summary.startFailed.context: First line of the load-error panel when the mod's initializer threw: vanilla still counts it as loaded, but most of it is missing.

name.description: Display name of the mod that failed to load.

loading.error.summary.loadedWithErrors.text: {name} loaded but reported a problem. You can usually keep playing; some of its features may not work.
loading.error.summary.loadedWithErrors.context: First line of the load-error panel when the mod loaded and reported other errors (not a failed initializer).

name.description: Display name of the mod that failed to load.

loading.error.cause.versionMismatch.text: Likely cause: this mod doesn't match the version of your game or of a mod it needs. Check whether its author has an update.
loading.error.cause.versionMismatch.context: Load-error panel hint when the error shows game or required-mod code the mod uses is missing.

loading.error.cause.missingDependency.text: Likely cause: it needs “{missing}”, which isn't installed or is the wrong version.
loading.error.cause.missingDependency.context: Load-error panel hint when a library the mod needs could not be found.

missing.description: Name of the missing library, usually a mod ID.

loading.error.cause.versionOrDependency.text: Likely cause: a mod it needs is missing, or it doesn't match your game version.
loading.error.cause.versionOrDependency.context: Load-error panel hint when only the error type is known and it fits both causes.

loading.error.technical.text: Technical details (include them when reporting the problem): {type}: {message}
loading.error.technical.context: Last line of the load-error panel.

loading.error.technicalType.text: Technical details (include them when reporting the problem): {type}
loading.error.technicalType.context: Last line of the load-error panel when only the exception type is known.

loading.error.disableContinue.tooltip.text: Turn this mod off, unload it from the current game, then continue with the remaining mods. It will stay off next time.
loading.error.disableContinue.tooltip.context: Tooltip for the action that turns off and unloads a failing mod before continuing.

loading.error.disableAndLaunch.tooltip.text: Turn this mod off, unload it from the current game, then start the game. It will stay off next time.
loading.error.disableAndLaunch.tooltip.context: Tooltip for the final-mod action that disables and runtime-unloads a failed DLL mod.

loading.error.disableForRestart.tooltip.text: This mod can't be unloaded from the current game. Pressing this turns it off for next time; then press Restart.

loading.error.retrySaveAndSkip.context: Load-error action after disabling a mod succeeded in game settings but saving the complete order before runtime unload failed.

loading.error.retryRuntimeUnload.context: Load-error action after the failed mod was disabled on disk but its collectible DLL context was still referenced.

name.description: Display name of the failed mod.

patches.description: Number of Harmony patch methods removed before unloading.

error.description: Reason the runtime unload could not be confirmed.

loading.error.runtimeUnloadFailedLog.text: ✕ {name} could not be unloaded from this session: {error}
loading.error.runtimeUnloadFailedLog.context: Load log line when runtime DLL rollback cannot be confirmed.

name.description: Display name of the failed mod.

error.description: Reason the runtime unload could not be confirmed.

loading.error.canonicalSaveStillFailed.text: The mod order still could not be saved. Loading remains paused: {error}

loading.error.disabledAndSkippedPreparin.text: Unloaded and skipped {name}. Preparing to start the game…
loading.error.disabledAndSkippedPreparin.context: Primary loading status after disabling and unloading the final failed mod before entering the game.

name.description: Display name of the disabled mod.

loading.error.disabledAndSkippedContinui.text: Unloaded and skipped {name}. Continuing with the remaining mods…
loading.error.disabledAndSkippedContinui.context: Primary loading status after disabling and unloading a failed mod before continuing the queue.

name.description: Display name of the disabled mod.

loading.error.disabledAndSkippedLaunchin.text: Unloaded {name}. Starting the game now; this mod will stay off next time.
loading.error.disabledAndSkippedLaunchin.context: Launcher status after unloading the final failed mod and saving its disabled state.

name.description: Display name of the disabled mod.

loading.error.disabledAndSkippedContinui.text: Unloaded and skipped {name}. Loading the remaining mods; this mod will stay off next time.
loading.error.disabledAndSkippedContinui.context: Launcher status after unloading a failed mod and saving its disabled state before continuing the queue.

name.description: Display name of the disabled mod.

loading.error.disabledAndSkippedSavedAnd.context: Load log after unloading the final failed mod and saving all launch state.

name.description: Display name of the disabled mod.

loading.error.disabledAndSkippedSavedAnd.text: − Unloaded and skipped {name}; your changes were saved.
loading.error.disabledAndSkippedSavedAnd.context: Load log after unloading a failed mod, saving all launch state, and continuing the queue.

name.description: Display name of the disabled mod.

loading.error.runtimeUnloadNeedsRestart.text: {name} is turned off for next time, but it can't be unloaded from the current game: {error}. Press Restart, then launch again from the mod manager.
loading.error.runtimeUnloadNeedsRestart.context: Shown after Unload & Continue when the failing mod was turned off for the next launch but this kind of mod cannot be removed from the running game; the player should use the Restart action.

error.description: Player-facing reason the mod cannot be unloaded now.

loading.error.restart.context: Load-error action that restarts the game and opens it on the mod manager again, the same as the in-game "back to manager" button.

loading.error.restart.tooltip.text: Restart the game and return to the mod manager, where you can change your mods before launching again.
loading.error.restart.tooltip.context: Tooltip for the load-error action that restarts the game into the mod manager.

loading.error.title.context: Load-error panel title naming the mod that failed or reported an error.

name.description: Display name of the failing mod.

loading.error.pausedAt.context: Primary loading status while the queue waits for a decision about a failed mod.

completed.description: Number of mods loaded so far, including the failed one; switched-off mods are not counted.

total.description: Number of mods that load; switched-off mods are not counted.

name.description: Display name of the mod requiring a decision.

loading.error.pausedPrompt.text: Loading is paused. Ignore the error and continue, turn {name} off and continue, or restart and return to the mod manager.
loading.error.pausedPrompt.context: Launcher status strip prompt while the queue waits for a decision about a failed mod.

name.description: Display name of the mod requiring a decision.

loading.error.guidance.text: To keep playing, choose Ignore & Continue. Turn this mod off first to stop loading it now and next time. Restart goes back to the mod manager so you can change your mods. Full details are in the log.
loading.error.guidance.context: Explanatory line at the bottom of the load-error panel before the player chooses a recovery action.

loading.error.canonicalEntryMissing.text: {name} could not be found in the saved mod order. Loading remains paused: {error}
loading.error.canonicalEntryMissing.context: Error while disabling a failed mod when its saved complete launch-order record cannot be found.

name.description: Display name of the failed mod.

loading.error.disableSaveFailed.text: {name} could not be turned off, so the change was cancelled. Loading remains paused: {error}
loading.error.disableSaveFailed.context: Error while disabling a failed mod when writing the game settings fails and memory is restored.

name.description: Display name of the failed mod.

loading.error.unload.notCollectible.text: this mod was loaded in a way that requires a game restart before it can be removed
loading.error.unload.notCollectible.context: Runtime-unload failure reason for native compatibility loading, an external load result, or an unavailable collectible loader.

loading.error.unload.foreignContext.text: this mod was loaded outside the launcher's control and requires a game restart
loading.error.unload.foreignContext.context: Runtime-unload failure reason when no collectible context is registered for the mod.

loading.error.unload.strayAssembly.text: part of this mod is still loaded ({detail}); restart the game to remove it completely

detail.description: Comma-separated names of the assemblies outside the collectible context.

loading.error.unload.cleanupFailed.text: some changes made by this mod could not be cleaned up: {detail}
loading.error.unload.cleanupFailed.context: Runtime-unload failure reason when Harmony cleanup or registry purging threw.

detail.description: Exception type and message from the failed cleanup step.

loading.error.unload.stillReferenced.text: the game or another mod is still using this mod. {detail}
loading.error.unload.stillReferenced.context: Runtime-unload failure reason when the context survives the forced collection pass.

detail.description: Sentences describing what still retains the context.

loading.error.unload.retainerNodes.text: {count} game object(s) from this mod are still active ({types}).
loading.error.unload.retainerNodes.context: Retainer note listing live Godot nodes that keep an unloaded mod's context alive.

count.description: Number of live nodes whose type comes from the mod.

types.description: Comma-separated sample of the node type names.

loading.error.unload.retainerHarmony.text: {count} change(s) from this mod are still active.
loading.error.unload.retainerHarmony.context: Retainer note reporting patches that survived the unpatch pass.

count.description: Number of patch methods still registered with Harmony.

loading.error.unload.retainerForeignStat.text: These loaded mods are still using it: {holders}.
loading.error.unload.retainerForeignStat.context: Retainer note naming other loaded mods whose static caches still reference the unloading mod.

holders.description: Semicolon-separated holder assemblies with their retaining field names.

loading.error.unload.retainerPurgeFailed.text: These related game items could not be cleaned up: {registries}.
loading.error.unload.retainerPurgeFailed.context: Retainer note listing vanilla registries whose reflection-based cleanup failed.

registries.description: Semicolon-separated registry names and failure types.

loading.error.unload.retainerUnknown.text: A task, timer, or another part of this mod may still be running.
loading.error.unload.retainerUnknown.context: Retainer note used when no specific retainer could be identified.

loading.error.settingsSavedCanonicalFail.text: {name} was turned off, but the mod order could not be saved. Loading remains paused; try again: {error}
loading.error.settingsSavedCanonicalFail.context: Error after disabling a failed mod in game settings but saving its complete launch order still fails.

name.description: Display name of the disabled mod.

loading.status.loading.context: Mod-list status while the highlighted queue item is currently loading.

loading.result.invocationError.context: Load log result when invoking a mod raised an exception.

loading.result.notProcessed.context: Load log fallback result for an unrecognized or unprocessed mod state.

loaded.description: Number of mods in the Loaded state.

loading.status.complete.text: All mods are loaded. The game is preparing its content.

loading.log.complete.text: Loaded {loaded} mod(s). Starting the game now.
loading.log.complete.context: Final mod-queue log line before vanilla game initialization starts.

loaded.description: Number of mods in the Loaded state.

mods.action.moveUp.tooltip.text: Move the selected mod up; hold to move continuously (Alt+↑).

mods.action.moveDown.tooltip.text: Move the selected mod down; hold to move continuously (Alt+↓).
mods.action.moveDown.tooltip.context: Tooltip for the move selected mod down icon button.

mods.action.enableAll.context: Button that enables all mods in the current filtered results.

mods.action.enableAll.tooltip.text: Enable every mod in the current filtered results, except those in folded groups. Required prerequisites are also enabled and moved before their dependents.
mods.action.enableAll.tooltip.context: Tooltip for Enable all. Mods inside folded group folders of the list view are left alone.

mods.action.disableAll.context: Button that disables all mods in the current filtered results.

mods.action.disableAll.tooltip.text: Disable every mod in the current filtered results, except those in folded groups.
mods.action.disableAll.tooltip.context: Tooltip for Disable all. Mods inside folded group folders of the list view are left alone.

mods.action.moveToGroup.context: Button that moves all mods in the current filtered results into a group.

mods.action.moveToGroup.tooltip.text: Move mods into one group: every mod in the current search or filter results, or just the selected mod when nothing is filtered.
mods.action.moveToGroup.tooltip.context: Tooltip for the Move to group button. Without a search or filter it only moves the selected mod.

mods.empty.message.text: No mods match the current filters.
mods.empty.message.context: Empty state shown when the mod list filters match nothing.

mods.empty.clearFilters.context: Button in the empty mod list state that resets search and filters.

mods.list.hint.folders.text: Click a group title (or press ←/→) to fold or unfold it; right-click it for subgroups and more. Drag ≡ to reorder; drop a mod on another group to move it there. Space switches the selected mod on or off; hold ▲/▼ or press Alt+↑/↓ to reorder within a group. Ctrl+Z undoes the last step.
mods.list.hint.folders.context: Hint under the mod list in the list (folder) view.

mods.list.hint.text: Right-click a mod to move it into a group; click a group tag above to show only that group. Drag ≡, hold ▲/▼, or press Alt+↑/↓ to reorder within a section.

mods.drag.showingAll.text: Showing every mod while you drag, so the row can be dropped anywhere. The filter comes back when you let go.
mods.drag.showingAll.context: Status line shown when a drag temporarily lifts the list filter.

mods.drag.hint.none.text: Drop on a group title to move the mod into that group, or on the top or bottom half of a mod to place it before or after.
mods.drag.hint.none.context: Status line while dragging a mod over a place where it cannot be dropped.

mods.drag.hint.before.text: Let go to place it before {name}.

mods.drag.hint.after.text: Let go to place it after {name}.
mods.drag.hint.after.context: Status line while dragging: dropping now puts the mod right after {name}.

group.description: Group name as shown, outer groups first.

mods.drag.hint.afterJoin.text: Let go to place it after {name} and move it into “{group}”.
mods.drag.hint.afterJoin.context: Status line while dragging in the list view: the drop also moves the mod into another group.

group.description: Group name as shown, outer groups first.

mods.drag.hint.into.text: Let go to move it into “{group}”. Its load position stays the same.
mods.drag.hint.into.context: Status line while dragging a mod over a group title: it joins the group without changing the load order.

group.description: Group name as shown, outer groups first.

groups.drag.hint.none.text: Drop on the middle of a group title to put this group inside it, or near the title's top or bottom edge to place it beside.

groups.drag.hint.after.context: Status line while dragging a group near the bottom edge of another group's title.

target.description: Name of the group it lands beside.

groups.drag.hint.nest.text: Let go to put group “{name}” inside “{parent}”.

groups.drag.hint.topLevel.context: Status line while dragging a group onto the ungrouped folder.

tour.launch.body.text:
[b]{launch}[/b] starts the game, saving the list first if it changed. [b]Organize[/b] puts prerequisites before the mods that need them; [b]Undo All[/b] goes back to how the screen opened.

[b]Not sure what to play? Surprise Me![/b] Switch on a random installed mod that is off, together with its prerequisites, then review your choice before launching.

[b]Want the original game? Play Vanilla![/b] Start this session without mods.

Show these buttons under [b]Settings → Customize[/b]. This preview does not change your settings.

tour.launch.body.controller.text:
Press [b]{start}[/b] anywhere to save the list and start the game. [b]Organize[/b] puts prerequisites first; [b]Undo All[/b] goes back to how the screen opened.

[b]Not sure what to play? Surprise Me![/b] Switch on a random installed mod that is off, together with its prerequisites, then review your choice before launching.

[b]Want the original game? Play Vanilla![/b] Start this session without mods.

Show these buttons under [b]Settings → Customize[/b]. This preview does not change your settings.
